text:
maya: Kicking off a staggered publish for the SDK (py -> npm -> docs sync). Starting with a small canary cohort. Will post status as each step completes. :eyes:
release-bot: publish job #4523 started
  - py: canary upload queued
  - npm: publish queued
  - docs: pending
ci-bot: CI check 'wheel-sign' FAILED on macos-latest: GPG signature not found
ben: Wait, I just saw a deprecation blurb in the release notes draft that references 'SDK v1'. Did someone add that? :confused:
maya: That was added by the docs automation when it detected an old import path in the sync-client PR. It's incorrect for this release — it only applies to a legacy shim we removed earlier. My mistake, don't want customers to see that yet.
sam: OK do not promote the deprecation note. For safety: keep PyPI canary, npm canary, and block updating 'latest' until we confirm signing and release notes are fixed. If anything slips, we should yank the PyPI wheel and remove npm 'latest'.
elenor: Signing key rotated last night on the build host; looks like the new key wasn't imported into the signing step's keyring. I'll import and re-run the sign job now.
release-bot: npm publish to canary succeeded for @redwood/sdk@0.12.0-canary
release-bot: py canary upload failed (wheel-sign) — awaiting re-run
maya: Commands I'll run / you can use if you need quick manual fixes:
```\n# re-sign and upload to PyPI
gpg --import /secrets/release.key && twine upload --sign dist/*
# if npm got promoted accidentally, move dist-tags:
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk latest || true
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@0.12.0-canary canary
```\nben: thumbs up. Also propose a rollback threshold: if Sentry errors > 2 unique customers or a unit-test regression in shipping clients, we pin back to 0.11.x and open an incident. Can we codify that in the publish checklist? :+1:
sam: Agreed. For PyPI, yanking is our immediate rollback option (we should avoid deleting files). For npm we can remove the 'latest' dist-tag and reassign it to the previous release. I'll jot commands in the checklist.
elenor: Re-sign finished, re-uploading wheels now.
release-bot: py canary upload successful -> uploaded @redwood/sdk 0.12.0rc1 (signed)
maya: I removed the deprecation paragraph from the release notes and pushed a docs PR to remove the automation flag that caused the false positive. PR: #4789. Docs sync will run after PyPI final succeeds.
ci-bot: docs-sync job queued (waiting on PyPI publish event)
ben: Good. Do we need to notify support teams about the canary cohort?
maya: Notifying support + success plans posted to #customer-success now. Also creating a follow-up ticket to audit the docs-automation flags (ops-issue/193).
release-bot: All canary steps green. Ready for full rollout if no customer regressions by 1766601400.
maya: Full rollout GO at 1766601400 — releasing to wider cohort and promoting npm 'latest' only after an extra 30m observation window. Release notes final: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/4789 :tada:
